moves.comment: Take the centre. This starts the London: one safe set-up you can use in almost every game.

children.comment: Bring the bishop out before e3 closes it in. This is the key London idea.
Guard d4 and f4 and free your f1 bishop. Your bishop on f4 is now safe.
Develop a knight. It guards d4 and e5.
Their bishop attacks yours. Step back to g3. If they take, retake with the h-pawn and the h-file opens.
Develop your last knight. From d2 it supports e4, which you can push later.
Guard d4 again. The pawns on c3, d4 and e3 are your London base.
Aim the bishop at h7 and get ready to castle.
Castle. Your king is safe and your rook joins the game.
Knight to e5. The d4 pawn and the bishop on g3 guard it. If ...Nxe5, dxe5 attacks the bishop and the knight.
Retake with the pawn. It attacks the bishop on d6 and the knight on f6, and Black cannot save both.
Black trades bishops. This is common.
Retake with the h-pawn. The h-file opens for your rook, and g4 can start a kingside attack later.
Aim the bishop at h7, next to Black's king. Get ready to castle.
Develop your last knight. From d2 it supports e4.

Trade queens. The attack on b2 is gone.
Develop calmly. The c4 pawn controls d3, so the bishop goes to e2. O-O and e4 are next.
Black offers to trade.

Black hits d4 early.

Retake with the queen. It stays central and eyes b5. Castle next.

Develop your last knight. It supports e4.
Guard d4. Castle next.
Black tries a pawn break too early.
Take the free pawn. Nothing guards e5, and your bishop is safe for now.
Their knight attacks your bishop. Retreat to g3. You stay a pawn up.
Kick the knight away. This also guards d4.
Black hits d4 at once. This is the most testing reply to the London.
Guard d4 and f4. If ...cxd4, retake with the e-pawn.
Guard d4 again. It also opens c2, so your queen can reach b3 if Black plays ...Qb6.
Black hits b2. Stay calm.
Guard b2 and offer a queen trade. You do not lose a pawn.

Retake with the a-pawn. The a-file opens for your rook, and your pawns are still fine.

Guard b2 with the queen. You cannot play Qb3 yet, because the pawn on c2 is in the way.
Develop a knight. It guards d4, so Black's queen cannot win that pawn later.
Retake with the pawn. Your centre is solid. Develop with Nc3 and Bd3.
Guard d4 once more. Then play Bd3 and castle.
